nodes.title: Ambush at the Smuggler's Crossing
nodes.description: You were hired to deliver a sealed iron lockbox to the Northern Bastion. But your caravan was just hit by raiders. You are bleeding, the caravan is burning, and the scavengers are closing in on the wreckage. You must protect the lockbox and survive.

nodes.title: The Long Road
nodes.description: The arduous trek across the irradiated dunes towards the nearest bastion of humanity.

nodes.title: Gates of Bastion
nodes.description: The player arrives at the heavily fortified town, but entry requires passing a harsh trial or paying a steep bribe.
